sentences.zh: 该禁令明确禁止销售19种具有军用枪支特征的特定武器。

sentences.en: And the story behind PLACA is a really fascinating one.
sentences.zh: 这些枪支就像AR-15，也就是纽敦枪击案中枪手使用的那种。

sentences.en: It starts in 1994 after a spate of mass shootings, including some shootings at schools.
sentences.zh: 它还取缔了弹容量超过10发的弹匣。

sentences.en: And Democrats in Congress decide that they want to push forward with a bill that would ban the
sentences.zh: 它有一个日落条款。

sentences.en: assault-style, you know, military-style weapons that were being used in these shootings.
sentences.zh: 国会规定它将持续10年。

sentences.en: So in 1994, as part of a broader crime bill, they pass what is now known as the assault weapons ban.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，美国全国步枪协会（NRA）对此非常、非常不满。

sentences.en: The ban prohibits by name the sale of 19 specific weapons that have the features of guns used in the military.
sentences.zh: 1994年是选举年。

sentences.en: And these are guns like the AR-15, which the shooter in
sentences.zh: 所以NRA基本上着手要击败尽可能多的民主党人。

sentences.en: Newtown used.
sentences.zh: 他们针对的是民主党最大的头目，众议院议长汤姆·福利，他来自华盛顿州。

sentences.en: And it also outlaws magazines that could hold more than 10 rounds of ammunition.
sentences.zh: 它还禁止了弹匣容量超过10发的弹匣。

sentences.en: It had a sunset provision.
sentences.zh: 它设有一个日落条款。

sentences.en: Congress said it was going to last for 10 years.
sentences.zh: 国会当时规定该法案有效期为10年。

sentences.en: And the NRA, not surprisingly, was very, very unhappy about this.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，美国全国步枪协会（NRA）对此感到非常、非常不满。

sentences.en: And 1994 is an election year.
sentences.zh: 而1994年恰逢选举年。

sentences.en: And so the NRA basically sets out to defeat as many Democrats as they possibly can.
sentences.zh: 因此，NRA基本上开始着手尽可能多地击败民主党人。

sentences.en: And they go after the biggest Democrat of all, the House Speaker Tom Foley, who was from Washington
sentences.zh: 他们甚至针对了民主党内最大的头目，即来自华盛顿州的众议院议长汤姆·福利。

sentences.en: State.
sentences.zh: 陈述。

sentences.en: Now, Foley had already ticked off the NRA by having a vote in the House on the assault weapons ban.
sentences.zh: 当时，福里已经在众议院就攻击性武器禁令进行了一次投票，这已经惹恼了全国步枪协会（NRA）。

sentences.en: But because he was Speaker, he didn't have to say whether he would vote for it or against it.
sentences.zh: 但因为他是议长，他不必说明自己是投赞成票还是反对票。

sentences.en: So he was neutral on it.
sentences.zh: 所以他在这个问题上保持中立。

sentences.en: But then there was a mass shooting in his state.
sentences.zh: 但后来他的州发生了一起大规模枪击事件。

sentences.en: And a reporter asked him after that, do you favor the assault weapons ban?
sentences.zh: 事后一位记者问他，你支持攻击性武器禁令吗？

sentences.en: And he said he did.
sentences.zh: 他说他支持。

sentences.en: So the NRA starts organizing aggressively against him.
sentences.zh: 于是全国步枪协会开始积极组织起来反对他。

sentences.en: And they even go so far as to send this actor, Charlton Heston, who was a gun rights activist, but also just a really well-known actor at the time.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至走得更远，派出了查尔顿·赫斯顿这位演员，他不仅是一位枪支权利活动家，当时也是一位非常有名的演员。

sentences.en: They send him to
sentences.zh: 他们派他去

sentences.en: Washington to campaign against Foley.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿开展反对福里的竞选活动。

sentences.en: And lo and behold, Foley loses.
sentences.zh: 结果不出所料，福里输了。

sentences.en: So in leaving, I thank you and I salute you.
sentences.zh: 所以临别之际，我感谢你们，并向你们致敬。

sentences.en: And I wish you all, those of you who are leaving with me and those who...
sentences.zh: 我祝愿你们所有人，那些和我一起离开的人，以及那些……

sentences.en: Not only does Foley lose, but it's a total wipeout for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 福里不仅输了，这对民主党来说也是一场彻底的惨败。

sentences.en: But this was a political earthquake with the fault line running right through Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅是一场政治地震，其断层线还直接穿过了国会山。

sentences.en: Democrats lost the House they'd controlled for all but four years since 1932.
sentences.zh: 民主党失去了自1932年以来除了四年之外一直控制的众议院。

sentences.en: Part of that was the Gingrich Revolution.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是“金里奇革命”。

sentences.en: But a big part of that was the gun issue and the mobilization of the NRA.
sentences.zh: 但很大一部分原因是枪支问题和全国步枪协会的动员。

sentences.en: And it really sent a message to Democrats that, you know, if you cross the NRA, your career is toaSt. So this is a huge victory for the NRA.
sentences.zh: 这确实向民主党传达了一个信息：如果你惹恼了全国步枪协会，你的职业生涯就完了。所以这对全国步枪协会来说是一场巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: I mean, they're knocking off the Speaker of the House.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们把众议院议长都拉下马了。

sentences.en: Yeah, huge.
sentences.zh: 是的，巨大。

sentences.en: Absolutely huge.
sentences.zh: 绝对巨大。

sentences.en: The last time a Speaker of the House lost his seat was in the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 众议院议长失去席位还要追溯到19世纪。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And this kind of really established the power of the NRA, but also the myth of the NRA, if you will,
sentences.zh: 这确实确立了全国步枪协会的力量，也可以说是全国步枪协会的神话，如果你愿意这么说的话，

sentences.en: as this kind of all-powerful group in Washington that could make or break a politician.
sentences.zh: 它被视为华盛顿那种能够决定政客成败的全能组织。

sentences.en: And yet the assault weapons ban has passed.
sentences.zh: 然而攻击性武器禁令还是通过了。

sentences.en: So the NRA has a lot of work to do.
sentences.zh: 所以全国步枪协会还有很多工作要做。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They did have a lot of work to do.
sentences.zh: 他们确实还有很多工作要做。

sentences.en: And they continue to fight.
sentences.zh: 而且他们继续战斗。

sentences.en: By 2000, that actor,
sentences.zh: 到了2000年，那位演员，

sentences.en: Charlton Heston, has become president of the NRA.
sentences.zh: 查尔顿·赫斯顿，已经成为了全国步枪协会的主席。

sentences.en: And he goes to the group's annual convention where thousands of gun enthusiasts come.
sentences.zh: 他参加了该组织的年度大会，成千上万的枪支爱好者来到现场。

sentences.en: And he gives this hellfire and brimstone speech.
sentences.zh: 他发表了一场慷慨激昂的演讲。

sentences.en: When loss of liberty is looming, as it is now, the siren sounds first in the hearts of freedom's vanguard.
sentences.zh: 当自由的丧失隐约可见时，正如现在这样，警报声首先在自由先锋的心中响起。

sentences.en: So as we set out this year to defeat the divisive forces that would take freedom away,
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们今年着手击败那些企图夺走自由的分裂势力时，

sentences.en: I want to say those fighting words.
sentences.zh: 我想说出那些战斗的誓言。

sentences.en: And he's holding this rifle above his head and he's daring gun control activists to take his weapons away.
sentences.zh: 他把那支步枪举过头顶，挑衅枪支管制活动人士来夺走他的武器。

sentences.en: And then he turns his fury right at Al Gore, who's running for president.
sentences.zh: 然后他把愤怒直接转向了正在竞选总统的阿尔·戈尔。

sentences.en: It was, you know, a declaration of war.
sentences.zh: 那简直就是，你知道的，宣战。

sentences.en: And then in 2002, something happened in Washington that I think really marked a turning point in this debate.
sentences.zh: 然后在2002年，华盛顿发生了一件事，我认为这确实标志着这场辩论的一个转折点。

sentences.en: And that was the case of the D.C.
sentences.zh: 那就是华盛顿特区

sentences.en: sniper.
sentences.zh: 狙击手案。

sentences.en: The shooting started yesterday at 5.20 p.m.
sentences.zh: 枪击事件始于昨天下午5点20分。

sentences.en: A bullet went through a window of this store, narrowly missing a clerk inside.
sentences.zh: 一颗子弹穿过了这家商店的窗户，险些击中里面的店员。

sentences.en: In early October, a shot was fired through the front window of a craft store in suburban Maryland.
sentences.zh: 10月初，一颗子弹射穿了马里兰州郊区一家工艺品店的前窗。

sentences.en: And people just thought it was like some random thing.
sentences.zh: 人们只是以为那是什么随机事件。

sentences.en: But then like an hour later.
sentences.zh: 但大约一小时后。

sentences.en: At 6.04 p.m., a middle-aged white man was killed outside of the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 下午6点04分，一名中年白人男子在超市外被杀。

sentences.en: Not far away, a 55-year-old government worker was shot and killed in the parking lot of a grocery store.
sentences.zh: 不远处，一名55岁的政府工作人员在一家杂货店的停车场被枪杀。

sentences.en: This morning, the murders resumed.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，谋杀案又开始了。

sentences.en: The next morning.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上。

sentences.en: At 7.41 a.m., another white man mowing his lawn.
sentences.zh: 早上7点41分，另一名正在修剪草坪的白人男子。

sentences.en: Four people were shot dead within a span of two hours.
sentences.zh: 两小时内有四人被枪杀。

sentences.en: At 8.12 a.m., an Indian man gassing up his can.
sentences.zh: 早上8点12分，一名正在给车加油的印度裔男子。

sentences.en: Minutes later, at 8.37, an Hispanic woman sitting, reading a book on a bench outside of a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，8点37分，一名坐在餐馆外长椅上看书的西班牙裔女性。

sentences.en: People were really frantic.
sentences.zh: 人们真的非常恐慌。

sentences.en: The young lady that I just seen about five minutes or ten minutes ago off the bus was laying right there, and it was just terrible.
sentences.zh: 我五分钟或十分钟前刚在公交车下看到的那个年轻女士就躺在那里，真是太可怕了。

sentences.en: Schools started keeping kids inside.
sentences.zh: 学校开始把孩子们关在室内。

sentences.en: You know, it's a sick mind.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个病态的心理。

sentences.en: It's obviously love terrorizing society.
sentences.zh: 这显然是喜欢恐吓社会。

sentences.en: I mean, it could be the new wave of terrorism.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可能是恐怖主义的新浪潮。

sentences.en: What better way to terrorize a neighborhood than to start killing people at random in different places, all within a given, you know, area.
sentences.zh: 还有什么比在不同地方随机杀人更能恐吓社区的呢，而且都在一个特定的区域内。

sentences.en: This man just doesn't know what he's done to us.
sentences.zh: 这个人根本不知道他对我们做了什么。

sentences.en: Angel.
sentences.zh: 天使。

sentences.en: Finally, nearly three weeks after the first shooting, these two guys, they were arrested.
sentences.zh: 最终，在第一次枪击事件发生近三周后，这两个家伙被捕了。

sentences.en: Prosecutors in Maryland said they will file six counts of first-degree murder against the two sniper suspects.
sentences.zh: 马里兰州的检察官表示，他们将对这两名狙击手嫌疑人提出六项一级谋杀指控。

sentences.en: By the time this ended, ten people were dead and three people were wounded.
sentences.zh: 到事件结束时，十人死亡，三人受伤。

sentences.en: And in 2004, the survivors and their families decided to sue the gun company and also the store that sold the gun to the snipers.
sentences.zh: 2004年，幸存者及其家属决定起诉枪支公司，以及向狙击手出售枪支的商店。

sentences.en: And what they alleged was that the store ran in a grossly negligent manner, that it lost
sentences.zh: 他们指控该商店的经营方式极其疏忽，它丢失了

sentences.en: track of its guns and it kept such shoddy records that it couldn't even account for the assault rifle that the sniper used.
sentences.zh: 其枪支的踪迹，并且记录做得如此糟糕，以至于连狙击手使用的攻击性步枪都无法核对。

sentences.en: So they sued the store and they also sued the gunmaker for continuing to sell its weapons to a store that it knew was operating in a shoddy way.
sentences.zh: 所以他们起诉了该商店，也起诉了枪支制造商，因为它继续向一家明知经营不善的商店出售武器。

sentences.en: And in 2004, Bushmaster, the maker of the gun, and also the store, settled for $2.5 million.
sentences.zh: 2004年，枪支制造商Bushmaster和那家商店以250万美元达成了和解。

sentences.en: And how big of a deal was that?
sentences.zh: 那件事有多重要？

sentences.en: Oh, it was a huge deal.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是一件大事。

sentences.en: It was the first time that a gun manufacturer had paid damages for negligence, resulting in the criminal use of a gun.
sentences.zh: 这是枪支制造商首次因疏忽导致枪支被犯罪使用而支付赔偿金。

sentences.en: And this opened the floodgates for other lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 这打开了其他诉讼的闸门。

sentences.en: Right away, New York City brought suit, joined like 30 other cities and localities suing the gun industry.
sentences.zh: 纽约市立即提起诉讼，联合了大约30个其他城市和地方政府起诉枪支行业。

sentences.en: And the NRA was just apoplectic.
sentences.zh: 全国步枪协会简直气疯了。

sentences.en: So what does the NRA do?
sentences.zh: 那么全国步枪协会做了什么？

sentences.en: So the NRA views these lawsuits as an existential threat.
sentences.zh: 全国步枪协会将这些诉讼视为生存威胁。

sentences.en: And they say that they are going to be put out of business if they continue.
sentences.zh: 他们说如果这些诉讼继续下去，他们就会倒闭。

sentences.en: And so they start pushing Congress for a law.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始推动国会立法。

sentences.en: And what they want is a law that will protect them against these lawsuits, which they say are frivolous.
sentences.zh: 他们想要一部法律来保护他们免受这些他们称之为轻率的诉讼。

sentences.en: They argue that this would be like the victims of a drunk driver suing the car manufacturer because the person who operated the car was drunk.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，这就像酒驾受害者起诉汽车制造商，因为开车的人喝醉了。

sentences.en: And so they put all their political muscle in Washington behind this effort to get this law passed.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们在华盛顿投入了所有的政治力量来推动这项法律的通过。

sentences.en: And what does Congress do?
sentences.zh: 国会是怎么做的？

sentences.en: Democrats in Congress are still feeling the bruises from the 1994 election.
sentences.zh: 国会中的民主党人仍然对1994年的选举心有余悸。

sentences.en: Like they don't want to have anything to do with gun control.
sentences.zh: 他们不想和枪支管制有任何瓜葛。

sentences.en: So in 2005, they pass PLACA.
sentences.zh: 所以2005年，他们通过了《武器合法商业保护法》（PLACA）。

sentences.en: It wipes out all these lawsuits, including the New York City suit.
sentences.zh: 它抹去了所有这些诉讼，包括纽约市的诉讼。

sentences.en: And basically, it's a broad-based immunity for gun manufacturers and gun sellers.
sentences.zh: 基本上，它为枪支制造商和销售商提供了广泛的豁免权。

sentences.en: Are you telling me that it's impossible to sue a gun manufacturer?
sentences.zh: 你是说起诉枪支制造商是不可能的吗？

sentences.en: Well, not completely impossible.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也不完全是不可能的。

sentences.en: There are some exceptions.
sentences.zh: 有一些例外。

sentences.en: There were six of them in PLACA.
sentences.zh: PLACA中有六个例外。

sentences.en: And over the years, many people have been trying to get around PLACA using those exceptions.
sentences.zh: 多年来，许多人一直试图利用这些例外绕过PLACA。

sentences.en: And among them is David Wheeler and the other Newtown families.
sentences.zh: 其中就包括大卫·惠勒和其他纽敦镇的家庭。

sentences.en: So they find a lawyer, and in 2014, they sued.
sentences.zh: 所以他们找了一位律师，并在2014年提起了诉讼。

sentences.en: And I talked to that lawyer, and he told me about his strategy to get around PLACA.
sentences.zh: 我和那位律师谈过，他告诉了我他绕过PLACA的策略。

sentences.en: And what is that strategy?
sentences.zh: 那个策略是什么？

sentences.en: So they focused on two exceptions.
sentences.zh: 他们专注于两个例外。

sentences.en: The first exception was something called negligent entrustment.
sentences.zh: 第一个例外被称为“疏忽委托”。

sentences.en: And that's basically legalese for saying that if somebody gives or sells a gun very carelessly to a person, posing a high risk of misusing it, that's negligent entrustment.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是法律术语，意思是如果有人非常粗心地把枪交给或卖给一个滥用风险很高的人，那就是疏忽委托。

sentences.en: You're giving something to somebody in a negligent way.
sentences.zh: 你以一种疏忽的方式把东西给了某人。

sentences.en: The other exception they focused on was something called the predicate exemption.
sentences.zh: 他们关注的另一个例外被称为“谓词豁免”。

sentences.en: And basically, that meant that you could sue if the sale of the gun violated any law of the state in which it was sold.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这意味着如果枪支的销售违反了销售所在州的任何法律，你就可以起诉。

sentences.en: So the lawyer for the families seized on Connecticut's unfair trade practices law.
sentences.zh: 所以这些家庭的律师抓住了康涅狄格州的不公平贸易行为法。

sentences.en: And basically, they waged a deception in marketing case.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们打了一场欺骗性营销的官司。

sentences.en: They argued that the messages that Bushmaster used in its advertising, like the man card thing, were specifically designed to appeal to troubled young people like the shooter
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，Bushmaster在广告中使用的信息，比如“男人卡”之类的东西，是专门设计用来吸引像纽敦案中

sentences.en: in the Newtown case.
sentences.zh: 枪手那样的问题青少年的。

sentences.en: The first strategy, then, is to go after the gun makers for knowingly selling guns to a person who might use them to harm someone.
sentences.zh: 那么第一个策略是起诉枪支制造商明知故犯，向可能伤害他人的人出售枪支。

sentences.en: And the second strategy is to go after the gun makers for marketing, for appealing to people who were prone to violence.
sentences.zh: 第二个策略是起诉枪支制造商的营销行为，因为它吸引了那些容易产生暴力倾向的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: And what happens in court with those strategies?
sentences.zh: 那么在法庭上，这些策略的结果如何？

sentences.en: So they go to state court in Connecticut, and the court throws both claims out.
sentences.zh: 他们去了康涅狄格州的州法院，法院驳回了这两项诉求。

sentences.en: The judge says negligent entrustment just doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 法官说疏忽委托的理由行不通。

sentences.en: But she also gave a hint to the lawyers on the predicate exemption side of their case.
sentences.zh: 但她也给律师们在谓词豁免方面的案件提供了一些暗示。

sentences.en: She said she was bound by a previous ruling to decide against them on the marketing claim.
sentences.zh: 她说她受之前的裁决约束，必须在营销主张上做出对他们不利的决定。

sentences.en: But she kind of hinted that if they appealed, the Connecticut Supreme Court might overrule her.
sentences.zh: 但她暗示，如果他们上诉，康涅狄格州最高法院可能会推翻她的裁决。

sentences.en: So that's what they did.
sentences.zh: 所以他们就是这么做的。

sentences.en: And in March of this year, they got a decision.
sentences.zh: 今年3月，他们得到了裁决。

sentences.en: Today, huge, hugely, hugely important ruling in Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 今天，康涅狄格州做出了一个非常、非常、非常重要的裁决。

sentences.en: The Connecticut Supreme Court ruled Sandy Hook families can sue Remington for how it marketed
sentences.zh: 康涅狄格州最高法院裁定，桑迪胡克小学的受害者家属可以起诉雷明顿公司，因为它营销

sentences.en: the AR-15-style rifle used in the school shooting that killed 20 children and six educators.
sentences.zh: 那款在校园枪击案中使用的AR-15式步枪，那场枪击案造成20名儿童和6名教育工作者死亡。

sentences.en: So in March of this year, the Connecticut Supreme Court basically gave the go-ahead for this lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 所以今年3月，康涅狄格州最高法院基本上为这起诉讼开了绿灯。

sentences.en: That seems pretty consequential.
sentences.zh: 这看起来影响深远。

sentences.en: Well, we know that the gun manufacturers are almost certainly going to appeal to the
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道枪支制造商几乎肯定会向

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 最高法院上诉。

sentences.en: But you're right.
sentences.zh: 但你是对的。

sentences.en: It is very consequential.
sentences.zh: 这确实影响深远。

sentences.en: And it's consequential for a few reasons.
sentences.zh: 而且它影响深远有几个原因。

sentences.en: First of all, you know, it could set the stage for other families to pursue similar suits around the country, providing kind of a legal roadmap for ways to get around PLACA.
sentences.zh: 首先，你知道，这可能为全国其他家庭提起类似诉讼奠定基础，提供了一种绕过PLACA的法律路线图。

sentences.en: And then if the suit goes to trial, the families are hoping to get internal documents from the
sentences.zh: 如果诉讼进入审判阶段，家属们希望获得枪支制造商的内部文件，

sentences.en: gun makers in much the same way as plaintiffs in the tobacco cases got internal documents
sentences.zh: 就像烟草案中的原告获得烟草公司的内部文件一样，

sentences.en: from the tobacco companies showing all of their deceptive marketing practices and things that they knew about how their product was harmful, etc.
sentences.zh: 显示他们所有的欺骗性营销行为，以及他们所知道的关于产品如何有害等等信息。

sentences.en: And if that happens, it could really be a whole new ballgame.
sentences.zh: 如果发生这种情况，那可能真的是一个全新的局面。

sentences.en: It could change the national discourse around guns.
sentences.zh: 它可能会改变全国关于枪支的讨论。

sentences.en: We could see maybe gun makers being regulated or more lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会看到枪支制造商受到监管，或者出现更多的诉讼。

sentences.en: And that could be, in effect, the undoing of PLACA.
sentences.zh: 这实际上可能导致PLACA的终结。

sentences.en: David, I want to understand, what do you want to happen?
sentences.zh: 大卫，我想了解，你希望发生什么？

sentences.en: What do you see as the best case scenario for how this strategy ends?
sentences.zh: 你认为这个策略最终的最佳结果是什么？

sentences.en: I would like the firearms industry to change the way they think about marketing their products.
sentences.zh: 我希望枪支行业改变他们思考产品营销的方式。

sentences.en: And I would like our culture to accept that there are some of these consumer products that need to be regulated more carefully.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们的文化能够接受，有些消费品需要更谨慎地进行监管。

sentences.en: What do you make of the argument that it isn't fair to hold the gun manufacturers accountable for the way people use their product?
sentences.zh: 你如何看待那种认为让枪支制造商为人们使用其产品的方式负责是不公平的论点？

sentences.en: That, you know, everyone who buys a gun understands that it's a lethal weapon.
sentences.zh: 那就是，你知道，每个买枪的人都知道它是致命武器。

sentences.en: They aren't learning that from advertising.
sentences.zh: 他们不是从广告里学到这些的。

sentences.en: What do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: That's certainly true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: True, if you're going to put the most lethal consumer product ever devised out into the
sentences.zh: 没错，如果你打算把有史以来最致命的消费品推向

sentences.en: public, then you ought to bear some responsibility for how you do that, the method by which you do that.
sentences.zh: 公众，那么你就应该为你推行的方式，即你所采用的方法承担一定的责任。

sentences.en: So, you know as well as anyone that the gun lobby in this country is really powerful.
sentences.zh: 所以，你和大家一样清楚，这个国家的枪支游说团体势力非常强大。

sentences.en: How likely do you think it is that this small step, this small but important step, makes a change?
sentences.zh: 你认为这一小步，这一小步但重要的一步，有多大可能带来改变？

sentences.en: The gun lobby in this country is powerful because people have had their eye on other things for 40 years, and they haven't been paying attention.
sentences.zh: 这个国家的枪支游说团体之所以强大，是因为过去40年来人们的目光一直被其他事情吸引，而没有关注这一点。

sentences.en: But that may not always be true.
sentences.zh: 但这未必会一直如此。

sentences.en: Things change.
sentences.zh: 事物在变化。

sentences.en: Cultural attitudes change.
sentences.zh: 文化观念在改变。

sentences.en: Takes a long time, but it does happen.
sentences.zh: 这需要很长时间，但确实会发生。

sentences.en: We have a long cultural history of changing things so that needless death is avoided.
sentences.zh: 我们有很长的文化历史，一直在努力改变现状，以避免不必要的死亡。

sentences.en: And the next time you get a prescription at CVS, right?
sentences.zh: 下次你去CVS药店拿处方药时，对吧？

sentences.en: The pill bottle top.
sentences.zh: 那个药瓶盖。

sentences.en: Designated drivers didn't exist 40 years ago.
sentences.zh: 40年前还没有“指定驾驶员”这个概念。

sentences.en: These are examples of us as a culture working to stop needless death.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我们作为一个文化群体，努力阻止不必要死亡的例子。

sentences.en: Unnecessary death.
sentences.zh: 不必要的死亡。

sentences.en: David, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, everyone.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: Are you a citizen of the United States of America?
sentences.zh: 你是美利坚合众国的公民吗？

sentences.en: Oh, gee.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: I just can't answer that question.
sentences.zh: 我无法回答那个问题。

sentences.en: On Thursday evening, during a speech in the Rose Garden, President Trump said he would end
sentences.zh: 周四晚上，特朗普总统在玫瑰园发表讲话时表示，他将结束

sentences.en: his effort to put a question about citizenship on the 2020 census, but would instead seek the same information through other means.
sentences.zh: 他在2020年人口普查中加入公民身份问题的努力，但会转而通过其他方式寻求同样的信息。

sentences.en: Today, I'm here to say we are not backing down on our effort to determine the citizenship status of the United States population.
sentences.zh: 今天，我站在这里是要说，我们不会放弃确定美国人口公民身份状况的努力。

sentences.en: Having been blocked by the courts, Trump said he would direct government agencies to provide every record needed to count the number of non-citizens in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在受到法院阻挠后，特朗普表示他将指示政府机构提供统计美国非公民人数所需的所有记录。

sentences.en: Knowing this information is vital to formulating sound public policy, whether the issue is health care, education, civil rights, or immigration.
sentences.zh: 了解这些信息对于制定合理的公共政策至关重要，无论是涉及医疗保健、教育、民权还是移民问题。

sentences.en: We must have a reliable count of how many citizens, non-citizens, and illegal aliens are in our country.
sentences.zh: 我们必须准确统计我国境内有多少公民、非公民和非法移民。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that beginning on Sunday, the Trump administration will carry out a series of nationwide raids to arrest and deport thousands of undocumented immigrants.
sentences.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，从周日开始，特朗普政府将开展一系列全国性突击行动，逮捕并驱逐数千名无证移民。

sentences.en: The raids will target about 2,000 immigrants who were ordered to leave the country but remained anyway,
sentences.zh: 这些突击行动将针对约2000名已被勒令离境但仍滞留国内的移民，

sentences.en: and are a show of force designed to discourage more migrants from trying to cross the southern border.
sentences.zh: 此举旨在展示力量，以劝阻更多移民试图越过南部边境。

sentences.zh: 温迪·多尔、克里斯·伍德、杰西卡·钟、亚历山德拉·李·杨、乔纳森·沃尔夫、丽莎·周、埃里克·克鲁普克、

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备假期接待客人的相关内容。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是睡到不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。
